fields.FN11: 应收账款净额（不含应收票据、应收款项融资及其他应收）
fields.FN44: 应付账款（不含应付票据及其他应付）

selection: use same six frozen reports; no replacement; first financial statement forecast appendix with explicit absolute annual columns; no aggregate receivable/payable substitution or unprinted residual
eligibility: explicit label matching exact account; million CNY unit; same-year E columns; printed historical amounts must match TDX at source and printed precision; record missing/ambiguous/combined scope per component, without imputing zero
comparison: unaltered direct report balances versus all four frozen capital-transmission predictions on identical eligible component positions; do not infer superiority from changed denominator
metrics: per component WAPE and mean absolute error / actual FY revenue
three-component gross MAE only on positions where all three eligible
decision: exposed diagnostic, no production adoption; report coverage before accuracy; no follow-up threshold or report selection tuning
boundary: balance subset not cashflow; later-acquired report and TDX history not strict PIT; observed historical matching not independent audit or proof all future scope unchanged
